context: Mei and Aoi gossip lightly about a club.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (ねぇ/まぁ/ものの/メンバー/他人) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ねぇ、あの読書クラブ、どう?
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle curious delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: まぁ、メンバーはみんな優しいよ。
lines.en: Well, the members are all kind.
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 新しいメンバーも、増えたの?
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 増えたものの、まだ少ないかな。
lines.en: They did, but it's still few.
lines.style: thoughtful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 他人と話すの、緊張しない?
lines.en: Don't you get nervous talking with strangers?
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: まぁ、最初は他人でも、すぐ慣れるよ。
lines.en: Well, even strangers at first, you soon get used to.
lines.style: reassuring barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ねぇ、私も入ってみようかな。
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: メンバーが喜ぶよ。ぜひ来てね!
lines.en: The members will be glad. Do come!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
